semantic_differences: Native ports use actual native operation callbacks and actual runtime Future where available; explicit scheduler replaces browser event queue. JS framework ports use actual mounted component/data lifecycle. No claim of identical unrelated runtime semantics.

candidate_evidence_locations.excerpt: Hotel coordination — A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge. Save callbacks can synchronously navigate. Preview is transient and owns a different quiet interval. Document-buffer responsibility: store-owned BufferBank

createWorkspace offers open(id), edit(text), close(), dispose(); createSearchPreview offers query(text), hide(). Store read/write/subscribe is synchronous; timer schedule(callback,delay), cancel(handle) is explicitly controlled. Document buffers are owned by the store BufferBank, while Badge owns only a live subscription. A store listener may call navigation synchronously. All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics.
